title: Practice the knight's L-shaped move.
goal: Move your knight from the square d5 to the square f6 in one move.
narration_seed: Knights travel in an L-shape and can jump over pieces.
hints: For the knight, count two squares in one direction, then one square sideways.
solution_text: Move your knight from the square d5 to the square f6.
success_text: You landed your knight on the square f6.
failure_text: Trace an L-shape from the square d5 before you move.
